title: Giving to the Lord
description: A lesson on giving as an expression of love, obedience, and trust in God.

cards.heading: Giving as an Expression of Love
cards.scriptureText: If you love me, keep my commands.
cards.body: A true Christian expresses love for the Lord through obedience. Giving is one of the clearest expressions of that love, because those who truly love are willing to give their time, resources, and even themselves.
cards.question: How does your giving reflect your love for God?

cards.heading: The Standard of Giving: Tithes
cards.scriptureText: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse...
cards.body: The Bible teaches that the tenth part of our income belongs to God. Tithing is not merely giving but returning to God what already belongs to Him.
cards.question: How do you understand the purpose of tithing in your spiritual life?

cards.heading: Freewill Offering
cards.body: Beyond the tithe, believers are encouraged to give willingly and joyfully. This offering should come from the heart and be given with gratitude, not reluctance.
cards.question: Do you give with joy or out of obligation?

cards.heading: Sacrificial Giving
cards.scriptureText: Their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.
cards.body: Sacrificial giving means giving even when it costs us something. It reflects deep trust in God and love for His work.
cards.question: Have you ever experienced sacrificial giving? What did it teach you?

cards.heading: What Should We Give?
cards.scriptureText: Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice.
cards.body: Giving is not limited to money. We are also called to give our bodies, our time, our thanksgiving, our worship, and our service to the Lord.
cards.question: What area of your life do you need to offer more fully to God?

cards.heading: The Rewards of Giving
cards.scriptureText: Store up for yourselves treasures in heaven.
cards.body: Giving pleases God, opens the way for His blessings, and lays up treasures in heaven that will never fade.
cards.question: How does eternal reward influence the way you give?
